svg.aria-label: Sketch after a photograph of a dozen novelty bitcoin tokens heaped on a brushed-metal table and seen from a low angle: round coins lying flat and stacked, each with a raised B and two short bars at its centre, a ring of small dots inside a plain rim, rows of fine code marks across the face, the thick edges of the stacked coins showing, and the sweeping arcs of a brushed surface behind them
